left.raw_text: Informed consent obtained prior to any screening procedure
Patient with moderate or severe chronic atopic dermatitis
Good general health ascertained by medical history, physical examination and laboratory determinations, showing no signs of clinically significant findings, except chronic atopic dermatitis
Negative pregnancy test (premenopausal female patient) at screening
and use of adequate contraceptive measures (both male and female patients) throughout the study and 30 days after the last cis-UCA dose
